snippet.title: Luduvo Devlog #2: The Future
snippet.description:
https://luduvo.com

This devlog mainly highlights updates we've made to the Luduvo platform over the course of the last month. We wanted to show this to the much broader public as this has been previously alpha tester exclusive until now! 🔥

Catch us here! 👋
